_comment: Colony quests shown on the Mission Board. Progress is computed live from MetaState (goal.type/target/key); when done you CLAIM the reward once (tracked in quests_claimed). Rewards grant Tech Data into the run inventory. The first three are PHASE-6 intro quests (goal types 'colony'/'stations'/'recipes') that guide a new player and complete early.

quests.name: Settle in — grow the colony to 4 goblins
Make it yours — build out the lair (3 stations)
First product — make something on a Process Line
Find a better tool — get any goblin to tier 2
Permanently upgrade a Steel Recycler to Lv 2
Seal the lair — oxygen fully restored
Restore every lair need to full
